frames.name: F00_READY
frames.note: GK_BASE_V1 SET/west, untouched

frames.name: F01_WEIGHT_SHIFT
frames.note: weight onto the RIGHT (save-side) foot, knees soften, head on the ball, hands drop

frames.name: F02_CROUCH
frames.note: hips down and onto the RIGHT leg, RIGHT knee deeper than the LEFT, arms back

frames.name: F03_PLANT_LOAD
frames.note: hips lowest and over the RIGHT foot; RIGHT leg accepts the weight, LEFT heel lifting (+14°), arms back, hands start toward the target

frames.name: F04_PUSH_OFF
frames.note: RIGHT leg extending from the planted toe (hips 2 px up), LEFT foot off the ground (−3,−6), both arms swinging forward and up toward the save side, elbows 35 % open

frames.name: F05_TOE_OFF
frames.note: RIGHT leg fully extended on the toe (boot +30°), hips 2 px up and driving up-left, LEFT leg unloaded and trailing, elbows 55 % open, gloves rising past the shoulder line

frames.name: F05b_LEAVING_GROUND
frames.note: first airborne tick: both feet just off the pitch, RIGHT leg still nearly straight from the push, LEFT knee bent behind, arms above the shoulders reaching up-left, elbows 70 % open

frames.name: F06_EARLY_FLIGHT
frames.note: hands leading up-left at the ball, torso stretching tall, legs trailing down-right and folding (0.90)

frames.name: F07_MID_FLIGHT
frames.note: arms straight and nearly at the contact angle, hips level with standing, legs folded and trailing down-right (0.86): the most compact moment of the leap

frames.name: F07b_BRIDGE
frames.note: the last GK_BASE_V1 frame with the contact art's proportions, palette and thinned outlines: arms fully extended up-left together, legs at the contact angle

frames.name: F06m_EARLY_FLIGHT_MOD
frames.note: moderate variant: elbows 70 % open, arms lower, legs less swept

frames.name: F07m_MID_FLIGHT_MOD
frames.note: moderate variant: elbows 85 % open, arm reach +2 px

frames.name: F07c_BRIDGE_PRO_A
frames.note: the contact art's own components with the arms 24° short of the contact direction and the knees more bent, 75 % outline: the first Pro-part frame, posed to match F07b's silhouette

frames.name: F08_BRIDGE_PRO
frames.note: arms 14° short, knees 6–8° more bent, 50 % outline (fading the base style out)

frames.name: F09_FINAL_EXTENSION
frames.note: arms 6° short, knees 2° short, 25 % outline: the last authored frame before the untouched contact PNG

frames.name: F11_POST_CONTACT
frames.note: momentum: body 6° past contact (CCW), gloves through the ball line, knees starting to fold

frames.name: F11b_APEX
frames.note: the rise has stopped; the body keeps turning over to the right side, gloves easing off the ball line

frames.name: F12_DESCENT
frames.note: falling toward the right side, arms folding down to brace, knees bending

frames.name: F12b_FALLING
frames.note: arms reaching for the pitch, knees folding further

frames.name: F13_GROUND_CONTACT
frames.note: right hip and forearm meet the pitch at the presentation root, gloves bracing under the chest, knees folded

frames.name: F13b_SETTLING
frames.note: trunk settling onto the right side, knees drawing up

frames.name: F14_ABSORB
frames.note: flat on the right side, torso compressed 6 %, arms tucked, knees up: the impact goes into the hip/forearm

frames.name: F15a_PUSH_UP
frames.note: upper body pushing up off the forearm/gloves (torso 42° up, foreshortened toward the camera), head turning to the play, knees drawn under

frames.name: F15a2_SITTING_UP
frames.note: trunk upright to the knees, head above the hips, hands on the pitch: the last Pro-part frame (60 % outline)

frames.name: F15a3_HALF_KNEEL
frames.note: sitting back on the RIGHT heel, LEFT foot planted forward, trunk low and just lifting, hands on the pitch/thigh; style 80 % toward the Pro look

frames.name: F15b_KNEELING
frames.note: RIGHT knee down (shin folded back), LEFT foot forward and planted, torso up, hands on the thigh, head up; style 55 %

frames.name: F16_RISING
frames.note: up on both feet in a deep crouch (hips 10 px down), hands coming up to the ready position; style 25 %

frames.name: F17_READY
frames.note: GK_BASE_V1 SET/west, untouched
